name: bun-hono-react-monorepo
description: Stateless Microsoft Entra ID SSO broker (.NET + React)

scripts.build: bun run build:server && bun run build:client
scripts.build:server: cd server && dotnet publish -c Release -o bin
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsgo -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && cd client && bunx tsgo -b --noEmit
scripts.typecheck:safe: bunx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && cd client && bunx tsc -b --noEmit
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist coverage server/bin server/obj client/dist
scripts.check:versions: bunx vite --version && bun pm ls react react-dom @vitejs/plugin-react
